top_issues: Primary breakdown bar and explainer banner compete heavily for focal attention.
Disparity between total balance and instant capacity numbers confuses entry-level users.
fixes: Collapse the tutorial banner into a dismissible info badge next to balance.
Add explicit tooltips explaining the relationship between balance and routing capacity.

top_issues: Before/After account state cards take up excessive visual weight relative to destination input.
Route details display technical node identifiers that increase cognitive load.
fixes: Condense the Before/After state comparison into a single delta visualization.
Default to showing human-readable peer aliases with expandable hex hashes.

top_issues: Action buttons share identical visual weights at the bottom of the modal.
Cryptographic proof hash is truncated without a direct copy action.
fixes: Promote 'Done' to primary accent style and keep export options subtle secondary.
Add an inline tap-to-copy icon on the proof hash line.

top_issues: High-contrast light QR code background creates a jarring glare in dark mode.
Inbound capacity constraints are placed away from the primary amount input.
fixes: Recolor QR container with subdued off-white or themed dark-inversion borders.
Group incoming capacity limits directly within the amount input field boundary.

top_issues: Dual order book columns create density overload alongside the basic swap inputs.
Collateral fine print is presented in dense low-contrast paragraphs.
fixes: Provide a simple/pro toggle to conceal the raw order book for standard swaps.
Structure fee and tariff terms into a scannable two-column key-value list.

top_issues: Red warning text at bottom conflicts with violet credit extension callout.
Multi-step leg progression on the right panel lacks status indicators.
fixes: Consolidate capacity extension actions into a unified modal workflow.
Add explicit numbered progress indicators showing atomic lock stages.

top_issues: Multiple action buttons across the top header disperse focus across varied tasks.
Status indicators and credit limits use multiple colors without an inline key.
fixes: Group management operations like dispute and extend into an overflow menu.
Attach a persistent legend for bar segments directly within the card frame.

top_issues: Split view leaves significant empty canvas space on the right side.
Repeating transaction states clutter list scanning with redundant pill badges.
fixes: Expand the transaction list width dynamically when no item is selected.
Simplify status indicators into clean, compact monochrome status icons.

top_issues: Duplicate screen state to 07 with no state transition or data variation.
Technical frame indices overshadow user-relevant timestamps and dates.
fixes: Surface transaction fee breakdowns and settlement latency metrics in side panel.
De-emphasize internal consensus frame IDs below standard wall-clock time.

top_issues: Pixel scale controls appear abstract and overly technical for non-designers.
Long scrolling vertical stack houses too many unrelated configuration tiers.
fixes: Replace pixel scale slider with intuitive density presets like Compact and Spaced.
Segment settings into distinct tabs for Display, Networks, and Security.

top_issues: Matrix of source and destination accounts creates repetitive card grids.
Explainer box on the right remains detached from user inputs on the left.
fixes: Convert balance source selection into a standard unified transfer selector.
Embed the operational summary directly above the submit button.

top_issues: Large empty void dominates the bottom-right portion of the layout.
Navigation cards look identical to operational data panels.
fixes: Adopt a clean grid layout that groups administrative sub-pages logically.
Style navigation links distinctly from data presentation cards.

top_issues: Testnet faucet triggers sit alongside real wallet balances without segregation.
Multiple action buttons stacked at the right base create visual noise.
fixes: Move developer faucet utilities into a clearly marked debug overlay.
Consolidate on-chain asset actions into standard deposit and withdraw buttons.

top_issues: Pool metric sidebar lacks context regarding utilization and historical yield.
Term duration pill buttons provide limited standard tenure selections.
fixes: Add APY estimates and active utilization rates to the right pool overview.
Allow custom tenure date inputs alongside fixed term selections.

top_issues: Extremely sparse layout with substantial dead space on the right side.
Governance and multisig concepts are presented in dense body text blocks.
fixes: Visualize signer threshold rules with interactive signer membership avatars.
Balance page density by bringing governance actions into two structured columns.

top_issues: Crucial proof export actions are placed at the bottom of a technical card.
Dispute mechanism requirements are explained in text without clear step flows.
fixes: Elevate 'Save evidence bundle' into a primary button at the top header.
Diagram the dispute challenge window stages visually.

top_issues: Table columns become cramped, truncating key financial quantities.
Header stat metrics lack clear separation between on-chain and off-chain exposure.
fixes: Add horizontal scrolling or column customization toggles for dense tabular rows.
Clarify header card titles with explicit custody tags.

top_issues: Command palette obscures relevant background context entirely.
List items display varying descriptive subtitles causing uneven line heights.
fixes: Apply a soft backdrop blur to preserve underlying operational awareness.
Standardize command row heights and align secondary descriptions.

overall.verdict: The interface demonstrates a disciplined, mathematically coherent design system tailored for verifiable balance mechanics. However, dense protocol concepts and uneven screen compositions hinder broader mainstream usability.
priority_fixes: Streamline collateral terminology and capacity bars into clear available-to-spend metrics.
Separate developer testnet tools and faucet buttons from production balance screens.
Refactor multi-step cross-chain swap capacity checks into an automated flow.
Balance asymmetric layouts by restructuring wide empty cards across desktop views.
Elevate evidence export and dispute execution controls on sovereignty screens.
